value_raw: Landed strata title — a real, legally distinct mechanism for multiple separate owners on adjacent parcels inside one gated-and-guarded development
notes: Filled 2026-07-18, replacing the first pass's untested descriptive note. Under the Strata Title Act 1985, gated-and-guarded landed cluster-home communities carry landed strata title — each house individually titled to its own separate owner, common facilities (gate/security) shared. Named Penang example: Permai Garden Residences (via search, not independently re-verified). Title issuance itself can take 'up to a few years' after purchase. Penang allows both standard individual-title landed purchase AND this landed-strata route; Selangor is stricter, limiting foreigners to strata/landed-strata only (propcashflow.my). Real mechanism confirmed; not tested against an actual multi-friend group purchase — paper-vs-practice divergence Not yet checked

fact_label: Malaysia My Second Home (MM2H) converts to permanent residency
value_raw: No
notes: Filled 2026-07-19 (Mei). The long-term residence program (Malaysia My Second Home, MM2H) is renewable and can be held for extended periods (5-20 years), but it is explicitly not a path to permanent residency — it's a long-term social visit pass. PR requires separate application after 5-10 years of continuous legal residence, independent of the program's own status. This is a material distinction not to be confused with the residence duration itself.
